annotation: Carbonic anhydrase 12; Reversible hydration of carbon dioxide. Belongs to the alpha-carbonic anhydrase family.

Carbonic anhydrase 9; Reversible hydration of carbon dioxide. Participates in pH regulation. May be involved in the control of cell proliferation and transformation. Appears to be a novel specific biomarker for a cervical neoplasia.

3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase, mitochondrial; May play a role in the biosynthesis of lipoic acid as well as longer chain fatty acids required for optimal mitochondrial function. Belongs to the thiolase-like superfamily. Beta-ketoacyl-ACP synthases family.
